method: Qualitative 2D reference observations -> manual engineering targets -> bounded IK -> robot FK checks
robot_coordinate_system: metres; +X forward, +Y robot left, +Z upward; pelvis fixed at world z=0.79

reference_requirements.requirement: Dominant flat hand; fingertips initially near lips/lower face
reference_requirements.implementation: Open right hand; fingertips aimed at a lower-face proxy
reference_requirements.remaining_deviation: No model lips, no actual lip contact, individual finger lengths differ

reference_requirements.requirement: Move forward toward recipient and slightly downward
reference_requirements.implementation: 12 intermediate wrist-pose targets; Slerp rotation and descending fingertip proxy

robot_measurements.fingertip_proxy_definition: right_palm site position + 0.17m times local hand longitudinal +X axis
robot_measurements.palm_normal_definition: Right wrist local +Y: verified by positive finger flexion moving toward +Y; local +X points longitudinally along fingers
robot_measurements.gap_interpretation: A lower bound to the head surface, not a lip measurement; source near-lip contact is not reproduced
robot_measurements.keyframe_error_compares_to: Agent-authored engineering targets only, not tracked human joints
